title: Dedicated autoscaler: priority scheduling + burst controls + utilization reporting enhancement
author: Priya Kumar
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets need better priority-aware autoscaling and clearer burst/throughput accounting for SLOs. This PR adds (1) a priority scheduling pass to the dedicated autoscaler so higher-tier customers get preferential capacity when constrained, (2) configurable burst token buckets and graceful shedding for transient spikes, and (3) expanded utilization and burst reporting metrics for Console and billing reconciliation.

Summary of changes: implemented a priority-aware allocation queue, introduced per-fleet tokenbucket config and smoothing parameters, surfaced new Prometheus metrics (dedicated_autoscaler_alloc_{success,fallback}, dedicated_tokenbucket_tokens, dedicated_queue_wait_seconds, dedicated_effective_utilization) and added dashboard panels + unit/integration tests. Also includes migration for existing fleet configs: missing burst config defaults to previous behavior (unchanged).

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked in ENG-1123
- [x] Unit tests for scheduler and tokenbucket
- [x] Integration test against a small dedicated fleet harness
- [x] Observability dashboards updated
- [x] Backwards-compatible config defaults and migration path
- [x] Release note drafted

High level commit summary: see commits field below for details.

Deployment notes: rollout to staging with feature flag enabled 24h smoke window. Canary on 5 small fleets for 6 hours (10% traffic) before global rollout. Config knobs: priority_weight (0-100), burst_capacity, burst_refill_rate, smoothing_alpha. Defaults set to preserve current throughput guarantees; operators can tune per-customer.

Rollback plan: disable priority scheduling feature flag and scale autoscaler replicas down to previous revision; tokenbucket config is safe (defaults preserve prior behavior).

Files of interest listed in files_changed.

release_notes: Enhancements to Dedicated autoscaler: priority-aware scheduling to favor higher-tier customers during constrained capacity, configurable burst token buckets with smoothing and graceful shedding, and new utilization/burst metrics for better billing and SLO visibility. Backwards compatible defaults; operators can tune per-fleet via new config knobs.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'dedicated_priority_scheduling' in staging first. Monitor dedicated_autoscaler_alloc_fallback and dedicated_queue_wait_seconds. If anomalies occur, disable flag and revert to previous autoscaler binary. Migration script scripts/upgrade/migrate_fleet_burst_defaults.sql included to populate burst defaults for existing fleets.
